correctness.rationale: For L=V⊕Λ²V, dim V=3, every Lie automorphism preserves Z(L)=Λ²V and has block form [A 0;B Λ²A] with A in GL3(q), B arbitrary q^9. Its fixed-space is zero precisely when det(A−I) and det(det(A)I−A) are nonzero, by Λ²A ≅ (det A)A^(−T); no characteristic restriction. Reconstructed all five disjoint rational-canonical types: irreducible cubic, irreducible quadratic+linear with norm-one exception, three distinct linear eigenvalues excluding reciprocal pairs, double+single repeated root including Jordan alternatives, triple root. Symbolic recombination yields q³(q^6−3q^5+q^4+4q^3+q²−3q−8−ε_q) eligible A, and multiplying by q^9 gives the claimed q^12 formula. Independently checked symbolic parity formulas and direct field matrix counts q=2,3, including 48 and 4860 eligible quotient automorphisms. Nonempty determinant-open locus in smooth irreducible GL3×A9 yields smooth geometrically irreducible dimension 18.
